name: Bluetooth Audio Fixer
author: MrClaro
description: Universal fix for dual-mode Bluetooth headphones stuck on BLE: forces BR/EDR discovery, re-pairs audio profiles, and resets the Bluetooth stack.

barWidget.description: Fixes dual-mode Bluetooth headphones that only show up as BLE or fail A2DP connection.

schema.label: BR/EDR scan duration (seconds)
schema.description: How long to scan on the BR/EDR (Classic Audio) transport when discovering or re-pairing headphones.

schema.label: Auto-repair when stuck on BLE
schema.description: If a normal connection fails or lands on BLE without an Audio Sink (A2DP), automatically re-pair over BR/EDR.

schema.label: Background BLE auto-heal
schema.description: Automatically trigger a BR/EDR re-pair in the background when a headphone connects in BLE-only mode.

schema.label: Set as default audio output on connect
schema.description: Automatically switch PipeWire default output to the headphone once connected.

schema.label: Preferred device MAC (optional)
schema.description: Optional MAC address for right-click quick connect. Leave empty to use the last selected or active audio device.
